llm.summary: This is a markdown-only Remix v2 code review guide that asks an agent to inspect relevant route code and does not add executable behavior or hidden data access.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is reviewing Remix v2 loaders, actions, revalidation, and defer/Await usage; the artifact content consistently supports that code-review purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: It asks the agent to read route modules, grep for framework holdovers, and check sensitive-looking return fields, which is expected for this review skill; references to adjacent Beagle review docs are purpose-related but may depend on other installed skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md and markdown reference files, with no scripts, binaries, lifecycle hooks, dependency installs, or executable payloads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading Remix source files under app/routes is proportionate to the stated review task. Mentions of passwords, tokens, API keys, and secrets are examples of fields not to leak, not instructions to access credential stores.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential use, network transfer, destructive action, or account mutation is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install for Remix v2 code review. Expect it to read relevant project source files and produce advisory findings about data-flow bugs and possible leaked fields; review findings against the actual code before making changes. It does not need credentials or special privileges.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; independent artifact review found no material concern.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal showed no malicious or suspicious detections, consistent with the markdown-only artifact set.
[static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and the inspected files contain review guidance and code examples rather than executable behavior.
